item.title: Making Caddy, AWS EC2, CloudWatch, Step Functions, and Lambda Work Together
item.description: I already ran Caddy at home for Home Assistant. This article is the AWS edge version: EC2 (often t4g.nano), automatic HTTPS, JSON access logs in CloudWatch, a nightly Python shipper, and Lambda + Step Functions for cheap observability — not a SaaS dashboard bill.
